text:
Tariq: heads-up: small bring-up of Veridian-lite q8 shows detok/tokenization gaps for CJK and RTL. quick summary: extra spaces before Japanese full stop, ZWJ removal in zh emoji sequences, and Arabic punctuation separated. initial 120-sample run attached. @Ayako @Jun can you triage?

Ayako: can you paste the minimal repro command?

Tariq: sure:
```bash
python infra/evals/roundtrip.py --model=veridian-lite --quant=q8 --samples=120 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=auto --out=/tmp/veridian_q8_rt.jsonl
```

Tariq: examples from the run:
- float baseline ja detok: "\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac\u3067\u3059\u3002"
- q8 detok: "\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac\u3067\u3059  \u3002"  <-- double space before punctuation

- float baseline zh: "\ud83d\ude0d\u200d\u7b11"
- q8 detok: "\ud83d\ude0d  \u7b11"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- float baseline ar: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c\u0627\u0644\u0641\u0627\u0643"
- q8 detok: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0627\u0644\u0627\u0645 \u060c \u0627\u0644\u0641\u0627\u0643"  <-- spaced comma

Jun: initial thought: tokenizer serialization or runtime detok flags mismatch between float and quant images. did we change normalize_zws or merge_punct recently?

Tariq: PR #3688 modified ZWSP normalization on load. float canaries got it but quant images might still be using the older serialized vocab.

Marta: canary bot spinning a pinned-tokenizer run with explicit `--detok=legacy` to see if behavior follows tokenizer version or runtime config.

canary-bot: Canary job started: canary/4987654321-1 (veridian-lite q8) 20 samples ja/zh/ar. ETA ~10m.

Jun: also request raw token id dumps for failing samples (we need byte-level ids) to tell if the tokenizer split differs or detok is changing spacing later.

Tariq: running a 30-sample debug with token ids and `--detok=norm-punct`, logging to /tmp/veridian_q8_debug.jsonl now.

Marta: mitigation idea: temporary routing rule to send ja/zh/ar traffic to float path at 90% until we confirm fix. needs SRE + product signoff.

Jun: if token ids match but detok differs, that points to the runtime detok normalization (quant fastpath) being out-of-sync config-wise. i'll check runtime config blobs in quant images.

Tariq: metrics: ja->en BLEU -1.6, zh->en -1.0, ar->en -3.9 (RTL punctuation heavy subset). chrF deltas smaller but consistent.

Ayako: action items: 1) compare tokenizer serialization used in quant images (Ayako) 2) Jun to inspect runtime detok flags in quant fastpath 3) run control with older quant build (q8-2026-03-02) as baseline 4) decide routing fallback if regression persists.

Tariq: i'll post debug outputs when ready. thanks team. :thumbsup:
